# GitHub Copilot Instructions

Read and follow `AGENTS.md` as the repository-wide engineering and evidence contract.

For Copilot-specific work:
- keep review batches small and tied to explicit record IDs or one coherent maintenance objective;
- never edit generated Markdown directly when canonical YAML or a generator is the real source;
- preserve uncertainty instead of guessing licence, lifecycle, ownership, or identity;
- prefer primary-source evidence and document what remains unresolved;
- run generation, validation, tests, formatting, and diff checks before proposing completion;
- leave merge and release decisions to a human.
